environment: Windows, Python 3.x, SQLite, single-worker uvicorn, localhost

atms_reduced.note: Same size (900 ATMs, was 5000 limit but only 900 in DB)

lazy_loading.description: I4C sub-views (mule, drift, ledger, model, inbox, handoffs) only render when first opened

debounced_filters.description: Filter changes debounced 300ms before triggering API calls
debounced_filters.impact: Prevents API storms on rapid filter changes

websocket_delta.description: WebSocket alerts update only alerts table + stats, not full dashboard reload
websocket_delta.before: Full loadAll() = 19 API calls per alert

abort_controller.description: Stale API requests cancelled when new ones start
abort_controller.impact: Prevents stale data overwriting fresh data

cached_sorted_risk.description: Risk array sorted once per load, reused across renders

reduced_complaints.description: Complaints fetched with limit=200 instead of limit=20000

alert_cycle_delta.description: Alert cycle refreshes only alerts + overview, not full dashboard

ledger_pagination.description: GET /ledger now accepts limit/offset, defaults to 50 records

mule_network_limit.description: GET /graph/mule-network accepts limit param, defaults to 100 nodes

cache_headers.description: API responses get appropriate Cache-Control headers
cache_headers.reference_data: 60s for bank list, i18n, train status

initial_load_after.note: 7 sub-view APIs deferred until first view activation
